Cell.Data:
For most people, World War II is finally over. Not for me. Until my husband Sean is accounted for, the war rages on.

I won't mince words, - Baumeister Confections is in shambles. And I simply can't focus on chocolate right now - I need someone else to manage the company.

For starters, I was wondering if you have any chocolate-making and business experience already under your belt. Would you like me to show you the ropes, perhaps?

If so, you need to show me you can make chocolates - and money. Once you have made at least [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000], I'll make you %rank_2% and start introducing you to the Board of Directors. What do you think?
See %main_alex% in %zurich% once you've made some %b03% and have at least [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000] on hand.
I need to be confident in your abilities to run our business, <player>. Come back and see me as soon as you've made 3 recipes and have at least [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000] on hand.

Alex has bigger fish to fry, <player>. She is antsy to hand over the reins so that she can search for Sean. She is waiting for you to learn 3 recipes and show up with at least [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000] on hand.

So, let's get started!

Here are 100 sacks each of %sugar% and %cacao%. Go see Endrit over at %zur_factory% to turn these ingredients into chocolates...
You are looking for %zur_factory%? It's the red brick factory in the middle of town...
Ah, Endrit! A brilliant boy, that one. He's running the %zur_factory% over at the brick factory by the canal. He'll look after you properly.
If you intend to fill my shelves, you'll need to visit the Chocolate Works first. It's the large industrial building in the center of town.

I feel for what Alex is going through, , but boy am I excited to get these machines working again!

Click "Make Chocolates" and make at least [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%...
Remember, you need to make at least [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%. Ready to try again? Just click "%make_chocolate%" and be sure to make at least [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%...

Your %b01% look delicious!

All products and ingredients appear in your inventory. You can mouse over items for more information...
Remember to make at least [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%.
You're going to need to make at least [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%. The only place you can do that is at the red brick chocolate factory here in the middle of town - %zur_factory%.

You have your ingredients, yes? Good. Head right over the bridge to the %zur_factory%. Endrit has been pacing all morning waiting for you to start those machines! He needs you to make [D|5|20|40] cases of %b01%.
I'm eagerly awaiting your first batch of %b01%! You'll need to head to the %zur_factory% just across the water to manufacture them. Please don't keep me waiting too long.

As you travel you can track how many products we're making in the status window below. Inventory levels for each ingredient we're using are shown with color-coded bars - green means we've got plenty, yellow means we're running low, and red means production will soon be stalled.

Speaking of ingredients, in order to keep making %b01% we'll need more %sugar% and %cacao% soon. You're going to need some money!

Visit %zur_shop% to turn your chocolates into cash...
You're trying to find %zur_shop%? It's the red building on the west side of the canal...

Now that you have manufactured some goods, it is time to liquidate them into cash, yes? Run those %b01% over to Analiese at %zur_shop% - you will find her shop on the opposite side of the canal, over the bridge.
Oh, your %b01% smell absolutely heavenly! You should take those straight to Analiese at %zur_shop%. She's just across the canal, and I know she pays very fairly for quality work.
You can't eat all those %b01% yourself. Like, I totally get the urge! But really, you need to take them to Analiese at the %zur_shop% and turn a profit.

Welcome, . Step inside to review my prices.

Once inside, click "%sell_all%" - I'll take your products and you'll get the cash!
Click "%sell_all%" to sell your chocolates to %zur_shopkeep%.
Remember, you need to click %sell_all% inside the shop to sell me your chocolates - you'll see the money you earned show up in your account.
The only place I know of in town where you'll be able to sell your chocolates is %zur_shop%. Click %sell_all% inside the shop to turn a profit on your creations...

Thank you for stopping by, . It is always my pleasure to offer the best prices for quality chocolates!

Now, go back and speak with Alex - you can find her at the %zur_station%, the main rail station here in %zurich%.

Alex would like to speak with you, <player>. She's preparing for her journey at the main train station here in %zurich%, %zur_station%. That's the building you'll find just in front of %zur_tower% church.

As I said earlier, it has been an pleasure doing business with you, <player>. I believe Mrs. Fletcher is still waiting for you at the %zur_station%. You'd best return to her so she knows of our successful transaction!

Well done, <player>. You've made some chocolates, and you've made some money. With the factory now operational, I suspect you'll be needing ingredients soon. It's time to restock your inventory of %cacao% and %sugar%.

I'm going to give you $5,000. Show me you're ready to take over by [D|doubling|tripling|quintupling] my investment. Now, go see %zur_marketkeep% here at %zur_market% about buying some of what you need.

By the way, you can keep track of all of your to-do's with the Quest Log window.
%zur_market% is the only place I know of here in %zurich% to buy ingredients. You'll find the market just to the right of the chocolate factory...
I gave you that capital for a reason, <player>. Go see Verena at the %zur_market% and secure some %sugar% so we can keep the factory running.
I heard Endrit practically shouting towards his factory floor about empty machines. You'd best secure those sacks of %sugar% from the %zur_market% before he loses his mind!

Good day to you. , isn't it? You must be the one working for the Baumeisters. As far as I'm aware, Alex surely is putting so much on her shoulders. I sincerely hope she doesn't wind up disappointed in the end.

Now then, I heard you're looking for %sugar%. We had so little for so long, but it feels good to have shelves that aren't bare. Please buy what you need - at least 200 sacks.
If you look below, <player>, you'll see the sack of sugar. Click that to proceed to purchasing some.
Well done, <player>. I am very happy to serve you.
Not quite there yet, though. You need %1% more sacks of sugar.
Click on %sugar% and then buy enough so that you've got at least 200 sacks on hand.
I don't think you bought enough %sugar%. You'll not feel secure until you have at least 200 sacks in your inventory. Trust me on this.
%zur_market% is the only place I know of here in %zurich% where you'll find the %sugar% you need. The market is just to the right of the chocolate factory...
I gave you that capital for a reason, <player>. Go see Verena at the %zur_market% and secure at least 200 sacks of %sugar% so we can keep the factory running.
I heard Endrit practically shouting towards his factory floor about empty machines. You'd best secure those sacks of %sugar% from the %zur_market% before he loses his mind!

In terms of %cacao%, it doesn't grow on European soil. For that, you'll need to travel to Africa. Particularly, to %douala%, Cameroon. If you look at your ledger, press the "Map" button to book a flight there. I have a dear friend there, %dou_marketkeep%, and she'll fix you up with what you need. Tell her that Verena sent you.
Click "Map" to travel to %douala% and purchase %cacao% at %dou_market%.
I understand you're after %cacao%. You need to click on the "Map" button on the left, and then click on the port of %douala% to travel there...
You looking to buy some %cacao%? See %dou_marketkeep% over at %dou_market%...
You look lost. If you came off your plane looking for %cacao%, you need to head into the noise of the %dou_market%. Look for Tomge. She runs a tight stall, so have your money ready.

Welcome to the plantation, my friend.

I may be a cacao farmer, but I'm not really your best subject right now. My own crop isn't ready for commercial sale. Tomge at the %dou_market% will have the sacks of %cacao% you require. I believe it'll fit your needs.
Ah, a visitor from Baumeister Confections. Welcome to Douala. If it is %cacao% you need, you must seek out Tomge at the %dou_market%. Just down the street...

Ah, so you are the one Verena wrote to me about! It is good to finally put a face to the name.

She mentioned you would need 200 sacks to get started, is that right? Let's get you all sorted.
Purchase enough %cacao% so that you've got at least 200 sacks on hand.
Everything is here for you. The cacao is in the large sack, just to the bottom left. Click on it when you are ready.
Sugar? Ha! You came all this way for sugar? My friend, you could have gotten that cheaper in %zurich%!
Good start, <player>, but you're not quite there yet. You need %1% more sacks of %cacao%.
Oh, is that all the money you got on hand? You should've cranked out some %b01% as you flew over here. Head to %dou_shop% across the road and %dou_shopkeep% can fix you up.
There you go, <player>! It's a pleasure doing business.
Careful now, you are still a bit short on %cacao%! Your factories will need more to remain in operation. Verena's message said you need 200 sacks of them to get started properly.

You need to have at least 200 sacks of %cacao% in your inventory, isn't that right?

The only place that I've heard of %cacao% for sale lately is at %dou_market% in %douala%...
I'm more than happy to stock your %b01% into my shop. I certainly can assist you with this, if you're seeking more cash to fund your investment in %cacao% at the %dou_market%.

The %cacao% should now be secure and ready to transport back to Switzerland. Now you need to fly back to %zurich% and see Alex.

She sounds familiar. Alex is from Baumeister Confections, isn't she? Finding her lost husband, didn't I hear? From my experience of working here as a woman, we all must have strong spirits to survive and thrive in this world, and I find Alex's spirit so admirable. Please send my thoughts to her.
Travel back to %zurich% to speak with Alex at the %zur_station%.
Alex would like to see you, <player>. She's still at the main train station in %zurich%, %zur_station%. That's the building just in front of %zur_tower% church.
The next flight bound for Europe leaves soon, <player>. You have your %cacao%. I suggest you get back to %zurich% and ease Alex's worries.

Your transaction is done, . The humidity here will melt you if you aren't used to it, I'm sure!

Better get those beans back to your boss in Switzerland. She's waiting at the station, isn't she?
A successful negotiation at the market, I presume? I wish you a safe flight back to Switzerland. I believe Mrs. Fletcher is awaiting you at the main train station in %zurich%.

I think you're starting to get the hang of things, , which is good, because I need to leave soon.

Next make your way back over to %zur_market% - Verena has a new ingredient you can use to make a new recipe, something that's always good for business...
Visit %zur_market% and see if Verena's got any new ingredients for sale.
<player>, make your way back over to %zur_market% - %zur_marketkeep% has some new ingredients you'll be able to use to make a new recipe...
My customers are always looking for something novel, <player>. If I were you, I would visit Verena at the %zur_market%. She always gets the finest new ingredients first.
Word travels fast! I assume you're here to purchase some of my %milk%, which just arrived? I trust you'll put it to good use.
Bring the ingredients to make %b02% - %milk%, %sugar% and %cacao% - to %zur_factory%.
I understand Alex would like us to manufacture some %b02%. You'll need to make sure you've got %cacao%, %sugar% and %milk% on hand to do so!
I understand you'd like to manufacture some %b02%. You'll need to make sure you've got %cacao%, %sugar% and %milk% on hand to do so!
As soon as you have %milk%, %sugar%, and %cacao% in your inventory, visit the factory here in %zurich% to make a new recipe - %b02%...
I understand you'd like to manufacture some %b02%. You'll need to make sure you've got %cacao%, %sugar% and %milk% on hand to do so!

Click "Change Recipe", select %b02%, and make as many as you can. More complicated recipes mean higher profits!

Keep trying until you've set production to at least [D|10|20|30] cases...
Make sure that you have the needed ingredients (%sugar%, %cacao% and %milk%) in inventory, select %b02%, and make at least [D|10|20|30] cases.

You're supposed to have at least [D|10|20|30] cases of your new recipe - %b02% - on hand. As long as you have %milk%, %sugar%, and %cacao% in your inventory, you can visit the factory in %zurich% to make more of the bars...

Nice work, .

Take [D|10|20|30] cases of those %b02% to %zur_towerkeep% at %zur_tower% here in town. I trust that you will find her quite generous...
Bring [D|10|20|30] cases of your %b02% to %zur_towerkeep% at %zur_tower%.
How delightful! I am going to take [D|10|20|30] cases of your %b02%, give you [D|$3,000|$6,500|$10,000], as well as 200 sacks of %caramel% in return.
My friend %zur_factorykeep% informed me that you'd be bringing [D|10|20|30] cases of %b02% to me one day - is my lucky day going to come soon?
You need to have at least [D|10|20|30] cases of %b02% on hand. Once you do, go see %zur_towerkeep% - you'll find her at %zur_tower% - just look for the clock tower...
%zur_towerkeep%'s likely managing affairs over at the %zur_tower%. You'd best make haste with those %b02% - she is a very busy woman!

Liridona has such a keen eye for harmony, , whether it's in her sketches or in the balance of perfect %b02%. You'll find her at the %zur_tower%.

Don't keep her waiting. She was one of my first friends in this city, and she's holding onto something handy for us!

Our dear Liridona at the %zur_tower% is expecting you. I saw her sketching by the Limmat earlier, talking about how much she was looking forward to your %b02%. She has a very sophisticated palate, so do make sure those [D|10|20|30] cases are perfect!

Liridona's opinion carries a lot of weight in Zürich's confection circles. Bringing her those [D|10|20|30] cases of %b02% you have on hand to %zur_tower% would be a very smart business move, <player>.

I want you to go back and see %zur_factorykeep%. As long as you have %caramel%, %sugar% and %cacao% in stock, you'll be able to make %b03%.

And I hear that Endrit has a new gizmo at the factory that he's eager to show you...
We need the ingredients for %b03% - %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel%.
Get a hold of the ingredients for %b03% - %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel% - and bring them to %zur_factory% in %zurich%.

I understand you're ready to work on your 3rd chocolate recipe! The only place you can do that is at the red brick chocolate factory in the middle of %zurich% - %zur_factory%. If you need %cacao%, you'll need to get yourself to %douala% - everything else can be found at the market in %zurich%.
Word is you need to get a hold of the ingredients for %b03%: %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel% - and bring them to %zur_factory% in %zurich%.
You'll make a pretty penny with %b03%, that's for sure. You need to have %sugar%, %cacao% and %caramel% in your inventory. Then, go to %zur_factory%, "Change Recipe" to %b03% and make some product!

Are you ready to attempt a more complex recipe, <player>? Along with your %cacao% and %sugar%, you'll need my fresh %caramel%, if you need any more. Grab what you need and take it all over to Endrit at the %zur_factory%.

You have on hand everything we need to make %b03%!

Click "Change Recipe", select %b03%, and make as many as you can!
Also, some good news, <player>. I've just wired up a Recycler for our machines. If you don't want to use what's in your gun, simply fire the ingredient at the Recycler - no more unnecessary waste!
Click "Change Recipe", select %b03%, and make as many as you can!
You need to make some %b03%. The required ingredients are %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel%...
Get a hold of the ingredients for %b03% - %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel% - and bring them to %zur_factory% in %zurich%.

I understand you're ready to work on your 3rd chocolate recipe! The only place you can do that is at the red brick chocolate factory in the middle of %zurich% - %zur_factory%. If you need %cacao%, you'll need to get yourself to %douala% - everything else can be found at the market in %zurich%.
Word is you need to get a hold of the ingredients for %b03%: %cacao%, %sugar% and %caramel% - and bring them to %zur_factory% in %zurich%.
You'll make a pretty penny with %b03%, that's for sure. You need to have %sugar%, %cacao% and %caramel% in your inventory. Then, go to %zur_factory%, "Change Recipe" to %b03% and make some product!

Are you ready to attempt a more complex recipe, <player>? Along with your %cacao% and %sugar%, you'll need my fresh %caramel%, if you need any more. Grab what you need and take it all over to Endrit at the %zur_factory%.
You'll make a pretty penny with %b03%, that's for sure. You need to have %sugar%, %cacao% and %caramel% in your inventory. Then, go to %zur_factory%, "Change Recipe" to %b03% and make some product!

You now know how to make 3 chocolate recipes. You can travel, buy ingredients and sell your products at a profit.

Once you've built your cash on hand to at least $10,000, Alex will be ready to hand you the reins to the company. Good luck!

You're well on your way, . As long as you've got the needed ingredients in your inventory, your factory will crank out chocolates as you travel.

I hear that Alex will be ready to make a move as soon as you've accumulated [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000]...

I have been keeping a close eye on your ledgers, . You are making steady progress! Just keep your factories supplied while you travel, and continue selling to Analiese.

Once your accounts hit the [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000] mark, Mrs. Fletcher will finally have the peace of mind to begin her search.

Alex is so incredibly anxious to begin looking for Sean, . You have such a good heart to help her.

If you keep my ingredients stocked in your inventory, your factory will work for you while you travel. Build up that [D|$10,000|$15,000|$25,000] cushion so she can finally lay her worries to rest and depart.
Alex is waiting to speak with you, <player>. She is anxious to be on her way. Please go see her in Zurich at the %zur_station% as soon as you can...

You've done it, ! You've shown that you have what it takes to run Baumeister Confections and turn a profit.

Alex has her bags packed and is waiting for you at the %zur_station%. Head over there as soon as you can so she can be on her way!
Mrs. Fletcher left explicit instructions - she is waiting for you at the %zur_station%. You'd best head over there so she can officially endorse your new role.

You have done wonderful work, young one. You have given Alex exactly the security she needed.

Make your way to the %zur_station%. She has her bags packed and is waiting to say her goodbyes to you.
You've proven to be quite the entrepreneur, <player>. Alex is waiting for you at the %zur_station% to finalize your new position. Do not keep her waiting!

There is a wonderful symmetry to what you've accomplished here, . A beautiful start to a new era for Baumeister Confections, isn't it?

I saw Alex gazing out toward the tracks near the %zur_station% earlier. You should go relieve her of her burdens and let her begin her journey to find her husband.

<player>, you've done it. You have shown your prowess at making chocolates, and making money. Now I simply must go. Ready or not, the company is in your hands. As I promised, you are now one of Baumeister Confections' %rank_2%s.

I genuinely understand, . I do like your moxie! But I won't lie; it's not easy for me to just hand the reins over like this to someone I barely know. I am counting on you to prove that you're doing what's right in my absence.

Ready or not, the company is in your hands. As I promised, you are now one of Baumeister Confections' %rank_2%s. I've saved [D|$20,000|$25,000|$30,000] in my bank balance to get you started.

There are 5 other members of the Baumeister Confections Board of Directors. You are going to need to work with each of them, one by one, to convince them that you are capable of being our CEO. Some you find easier to work with than others, but they are all good people.

I am off to launch my search for Sean. I'll be in touch as I can, and you should also keep an eye out on your travels for my assistant, %announcer%. If necessary, the rest of the board and I will be able to get messages to you through Rick.

Right now you need to go see my uncle Felix Baumeister in %capetown%. I think he's the best board member to begin with. Also, I understand that he's been working on some secret projects that may have significant impact on our business.

I know you can do it, - good luck!
Track down Felix Baumeister in %capetown%, South Africa.
Track down Felix Baumeister in %capetown%, South Africa.
If you're interested in speaking with %main_feli%, you need to go see him at %cap_factory% in %capetown%, South Africa.
If you're interested in speaking with %main_feli%, you need to go see him at %cap_factory% in %capetown%, South Africa.
If you are trying to find Felix, head over to %cap_factory%, behind the %cap_shop%.
If you are trying to find Felix, head over to %cap_factory%, behind the %cap_shop%.

You're working with Endrit over at the factory, aren't you? He tries to act all business-like, but don't let him fool you. He was practically bouncing off the walls with excitement when Alex told him they were firing up the machines again.

We grew up in the same neighborhood, you know. He's been obsessed with how things work for as long as I've known him, ever since his family sought refuge from Albania...

Sean was flying for the Americans, and his plane was lost on a 'secret mission' towards the end of the war. The authorities have been no help, so I have no choice but to try to find out what happened to him. I simply refuse to believe that he's dead. I know that I can count on you to turn things around in my absence...
I just won't be able to rest until I know for sure what has happened to Sean - one way or the other. In the meantime, I know that I can count on you to turn things around in my absence.

Pretty soon now, <player>, I'll be harvesting my first crop of specialty cacao. Sure it will be a bit more expensive than your ordinary cacao, but worth every penny. And, if you've got recipes that call for %dou_cacao%, nothing else will do!
Well, there she goes. I sure hope Alexandra knows what she's doing...
Well, there she goes. I sure hope Alexandra knows what she's doing...
